name: hud_ui_check_toggle_widget_refresh_state
description: HudUiCheckToggleWidget::RefreshState updates check-toggle image state and label visibility for enabled and disabled modes.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiCheckToggleWidget source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b70c0 validates hiding rollover and activate label spans, toggling normal/disabled label spans according to modeOrEnabled, selecting checkedImage or uncheckedImage for enabled checked state, selecting disabledCheckedImage or disabledCheckedFallbackImage for disabled checked state, calling HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate when an image is selected, and dispatching ftable slot 8/offset 0x20 Invalidate.

Native smoke zhud_check_toggle_widget_helpers_smoke verifies enabled checked refresh selects checkedImage and shows normal labels while hiding rollover, activate, and disabled labels, and disabled checked refresh with no disabledCheckedImage selects disabledCheckedFallbackImage, hides normal labels, and shows disabled labels.
